office_does: The district court judge hears misdemeanor and other criminal cases and civil cases for Asotin County and the Cities of Clarkston and Asotin.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Tina L. Kernan, on the bench since 2016, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Asotin County District Court judge since 2016, previously a superior court commissioner, running unopposed.
highlights: District Court judge since January 2016; elected 2016, 2018 and 2022 [S1][S4]
Superior Court commissioner from 2014; 23 years as an attorney before the bench [S1]
Hears criminal and civil cases for the county and the Cities of Clarkston and Asotin [S1]
